name: Heirloom
description: Open-source, self-hosted family tree application with PostgreSQL, media uploads, GEDCOM support and an optional AI assistant.

notes.text: The installer generates random PostgreSQL and JWT secrets and stores the deployment configuration in /opt/heirloom/.env.
The web interface is exposed on port 8081. Upstream images are currently published as linux/amd64 by the project's CI.
